$comment: v2.3 plan 01 §A. The production typecheck excludes src/**/*.test.ts, so an obsolete API call in a promoted reproduction would go unnoticed until it 'failed as expected' for the wrong reason (Astra review, 2026-09-20). Scoped to the evidence surface — the promoted reproductions, the ledger and the independent fixture — because the pre-existing test corpus has 18 type errors in 10 files that predate this plan; widening the include is follow-up work, not a silent debt. Module/moduleResolution are inherited on purpose: overriding them to CommonJS/Node loses the Bundler resolution the source relies on.
